guard: The cross-package index seam: the cells this suite EXECUTED, checked against the list the language package's matrix cites. Source text cannot answer this - `c` is silent on success, so a commented-out or dead cell keeps its sentence in the file while the claim stops being made.

mutations.name: the record stops recording, so the seam cell certifies an empty run
mutations.find: const c = (n: string, v: boolean, extra?: unknown) => { EXECUTED.push(n);
mutations.replace: const c = (n: string, v: boolean, extra?: unknown) => {
mutations.expectRed: every cell the language package's matrix cites from this file is one THIS RUN executed, exactly once
mutations.cell: every cell the language package's matrix cites from this file is one THIS RUN executed, exactly once
mutations.note: THE MUTATION THAT MATTERS, because the whole close is the difference between a sentence being PRESENT and a cell having RUN. With the push removed the list is empty and every cited sentence has zero executions. A cell that stayed green here would be reading the file rather than the run, which is the defect this seam exists to replace.

mutations.name: the seam file names a different suite and this one accepts it
mutations.expectRed: the cited-cells file names this suite, so it is this file's seam and not another's
mutations.cell: the cited-cells file names this suite, so it is this file's seam and not another's
mutations.note: The artefact is shared with another package, so it can be edited by a lane that does not run this suite. Without this cell a seam file re-pointed at another suite would be read here anyway and its list checked against the wrong run's cells - green, and about the wrong file.

why: MUTATES THE SUITE AND ITS DATA FILE rather than `src`, because the rule here is about the
instrument and not about the driver. That is unusual in this directory and deliberate: the claim
is `this list names cells that ran`, and the only way to break it is to break the recording or
re-point the list. A src mutation would grade the driver again, which the other configs do.
